verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS tax platform that stores transaction data, so the axis applies. The pack only shows a pricing-tier 'Archive of historical sales tax data', which is a retention feature the vendor provides, not a user control over retention or deletion. Nothing documents deleting transactions, retention settings, or account data deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
